# Conte Games Studio

> Independent mobile game studio based in Saint-Chamond, France. Games and apps for iPhone, with Android versions on the way. The website is available in 70 languages.

Contact: contegamesstudio@gmail.com

## Games

- [COCOBOUM!](https://contegames.com/en/cocoboum/): Play COCOBOUM!, a free iPhone game: pop bubbles, beat levels, challenge other players in duels and climb the global leaderboard.
- [Royaume des Mots Croisés](https://contegames.com/en/royaumedesmotscroises/): Solve crosswords, earn coins and grow a medieval village in Royaume des Mots Croisés, now available on iPhone.
- [Mieux Chaque Jour](https://contegames.com/en/mieuxchaquejour/): Mieux Chaque Jour: a well-being app with nutrition and yoga to help you make progress every day. Available on iPhone.
- [Les Tableaux Ensorcelés](https://contegames.com/en/tableauxensorceles/): Play Les Tableaux Ensorcelés for free on iPhone and iPad, with no ads. Complete 50 magical puzzles and restore an enchanted castle.
- [Caligula vs Gladiators](https://contegames.com/en/caligulavsgladiators/): Caligula vs Gladiators: face gladiators and wild beasts in the arena, earn stars and coins, and get a thumbs-up from Caligula. Coming soon to iPhone and Android.
- [Sauve qui Flèche ! Casse-tête](https://contegames.com/en/sauvequifleche/): Sauve qui Flèche! (Arrow Escape): get every arrow off the board in the right order through medieval levels full of keys, doors and teleporters. Coming soon to iPhone and Android.
- [Royaume des Énigmes](https://contegames.com/en/royaumedesenigmes/): Royaume des Énigmes (The Kingdom of Riddles): match symbols, solve riddles and defeat 3 bosses across 30 levels, with 6 bonus games and 50 relics to collect. Coming soon to iPhone and Android.
